text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Alright Trainer, let's hurry up
and set our plans for what comes next!
Tamamo Cross achieved brilliant results across multiple graded races, and was ready to move on to her next goal.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, give it to me straight.
Is my... is my body...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Are ya finally ready to take aim?
At the big ones in the Senior Class—the GⅠ races, that is."
choice_data_list: Yeah, your body's in more than enough shape!
Yeah, your condition is more than ready!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Alllriiiight! Nobody's gonna be looking down
on me from here on out!!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I'll show every single one of 'em.
This year, I'm gonna win and win and keep on winning!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
So Trainer, there's a race I just gotta run in.
A race I have to run.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
The Tenno Sho (Spring)! 
Back then, my dad told me...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross's Father
text_block_list.text:
When it comes to GⅠs, it's gotta be the Tenno Sho.
The Derby's great and all, but nothing beats the Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross's Father
text_block_list.text:
It's a race I've watched with special feelings for decades now, ya see...
Yeah... it's my dream.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross's Father
text_block_list.text: If only Tama would run in the Tenno Sho...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: The Tenno Sho is a race that means a whole lot to my dad, y'see. That's why...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"I wanna do something nice for my folks first.
I really wanna run in it... Can I?"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! Thanks a bunch!
I'll call home right away later.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Dad's gonna jump for joy!
I'm so glad I made it in time.

Tamamo Cross looked happy.
However, the problem was...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: What's wrong? You've got quite the sour look on your face.
choice_data_list: I guess the problem is the distance.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Distance... Are ya sayin' 3200m
is just too tough for me?
choice_data_list: Distance aptitude isn't a problem, but I'd like to gain more experience.

text_block_list.text:
"Between a one-lap race and a two-lap race, pace distribution
and strategy are completely different."

I want to take as many preparatory steps in long-distance races as possible before the main event.
To do that—
choice_data_list: Let's enter the GⅡ Hanshin Daishoten.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"The Hanshin Daishoten... If I remember right, that's 3000m.
And what's more, it's back home in Kansai..."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Alright! First, we'll warm up our legs on home turf.
And then we march on Kyoto!

And so, the first target race of the Senior Class
was decided to be the Hanshin Daishoten.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
By the way, Trainer,
got a bit of time right now?
choice_data_list: I have one, but what about it?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: She's got a race this afternoon. You know, her.
And where I was brought to was—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Go for it! Blow 'em away, Oguri--!!
(WAAAAAAAAAAAAH!!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap!
Oguri Cap claims a resounding victory!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
She may be a regional Umamusume, but...
What is this explosive power?!
I feel like I've just caught a glimpse of terrifying talent!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Whoa, whoa, not bad at all! Look at that, Trainer. That girl who wasn't used to the water is growin' by leaps and bounds...!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"As a senior, gotta look out for 'em.
If anything comes up, I'm countin' on ya."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Still, that girl... she runs real nice.
How should I put it, it's like...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"It's unrefined, yet somehow carries an incredible flair...
What is this racing style that just pulls you right in...?"

Oguri Cap had a look of relief on her face.
That race certainly held a charm... quite distinct from sheer strength.

I can't quite put into words
what makes it so captivating. Either way, for now,
let's focus on the Hanshin Daishoten.
